children.title: Trump uses “vermin” language about political opponents
children.description_medium: Around Veterans Day 2023, Donald Trump said he would “root out” political opponents he described as living “like vermin” within the country. The remarks appeared in a Veterans Day message and campaign rhetoric and drew criticism for their dehumanizing historical associations. The supplied evidence dates this episode to November 11, 2023, not January 2025.
children.description_long: In a Veterans Day message and campaign rhetoric on November 11, 2023, Donald Trump said he would “root out” political opponents whom he described as living “like vermin” within the country. The contemporaneous report reproduced the language and placed it in the context of his political messaging around Veterans Day. The remarks drew criticism over their dehumanizing wording and historical associations. The supplied evidence locates this episode in 2023, not January 2025. It is separate from Trump’s later “enemy from within” comments during the 2024 campaign, which were reported in October of that year and concerned a different statement and setting. The evidence supports reporting the words and the resulting criticism with attribution; it does not establish predictions about future violence or an unqualified claim about intent. Keeping the episode distinct preserves its date and context. The source describes this as campaign rhetoric in a Veterans Day message, rather than a government policy or agency action.
children.date_uncertainty: Date is the Veterans Day statement/report date identified by the supplied source.

children.title: Trump describes domestic opponents as “enemy from within”
children.description_medium: During the 2024 campaign, Donald Trump described domestic political opponents as “the enemy from within” and discussed possible use of the National Guard or military in response to disorder. Reuters reported the remarks in October 2024 amid campaign criticism. This episode was separate from his “vermin” language around Veterans Day 2023.
children.description_long: During the 2024 presidential campaign, Donald Trump referred to domestic political opponents as “the enemy from within” and discussed the possible use of the National Guard or military in response to disorder. Reuters reported the remarks in October 2024 as political opponents criticized the comments. The supplied source supports the existence and campaign context of the rhetoric and its reported date; it does not establish predictions that the language would cause violence or assertions about deliberate incitement as factual conclusions. This episode occurred months after Trump’s Veterans Day 2023 use of “vermin” language and should not be combined with that statement. The two episodes used different phrases, occurred in different campaign contexts and have separate source dates. Describing them individually avoids assigning the October 2024 remarks to a January 2025 event. The supplied Reuters title places Harris’s criticism at a Pennsylvania rally; it does not place Trump’s quoted remarks at that event.
children.date_uncertainty: Proposed date is remarks date; supplied Reuters article is dated October 14, 2024.
children.notes: Root provenance review: Reuters source title describes Harris's Pennsylvania rally criticism, not the setting of Trump's remarks.

rationale: The packet supports two separate rhetorical episodes; unsupported claims about intent or resulting violence are omitted.

review_notes.reason: Corrected attribution of Pennsylvania rally from Trump remarks to Harris criticism, based on exact supplied Reuters title; no outside research.
